requirements.title: Typed deployment, target, release and operation identities
requirements.description: Selectors resolve to stable identities; ambiguous scenario-name selectors return a typed conflict; duplicate request keys with different content are rejected.

validation.notes: Selector grammar, distinct installations resolve distinctly, ambiguous selector is typed conflict. Tagged [REQ:STC-P0-015].
Identity stable across host change, uniqueness constraint, legacy record conversion preserves identity and target binding.
Duplicate request key with different plan digest is refused with request_key_conflict; same digest replays.
REST resolve endpoint and Connect DeploymentsService return typed ref or typed conflict; manifest resubmit keeps the deployment id.
Deployment message round-trips through protojson with proto names; UI fixture parity.
UI parses the shared Deployment fixture through the generated schema.

requirements.title: One executable plan for preview, policy and apply
requirements.description: Preview and apply consume the same typed action graph and canonical semantic digest; changed target, artifact, privilege or destructive effect invalidates prior review; satisfied desired state yields a no-op plan.

validation.notes: Deterministic semantic digest (100 iterations, map ordering, JSON round trip); presentation-only change keeps the digest; target/artifact/closure/configuration/data-schema/privilege/strategy changes change it and invalidate review; typed inputs carry no shell; no-op only when observed digests match; needs_input yields one onboarding handoff. Tagged [REQ:STC-P0-016].

Preview/apply equality for every fixture in fixtures/workloads across install, runtime, start and retire scopes against a stateful fake target; every reach call attributed to a previewed action and validated by reach.ValidateCommand; undeclared effect refused; needs_input plan executes nothing; failed release.verify stops before stage/activate.

Preview creates no cloud_operations rows and no SSH calls; apply requires the reviewed digest (400/409 plan_digest_mismatch), admits one operation and replays under the same request key; injected fence bump after preview yields plan_stale with zero rows/effects; no_op apply admits nothing; needs_input returns 428 with the handoff; Connect PlansService returns the REST digest; /vps/setup/apply refuses without/with a wrong digest before reaching the target.
Plan and preview round-trip through plans.proto with proto names and keep the semantic digest; typed error detail on Connect failures.

Legacy step view is derived from the executable plan (ids = action ids, no cleanup_scenarios, stage never extracts into the live workdir, preserve paths become data.inventory/release.activate inputs). Install scope stages through the target owner's release verify/stage verbs and delegates host repair to the privilege broker; activation belongs to the runtime scope; recorded data-binding mappings win over the heuristic.
Action vocabulary, schema version rules, digest rules, outcomes and endpoints.

requirements.title: Typed errors shared by API, CLI and UI
requirements.description: Errors carry stable codes, retryability and next-action references consumed by generated clients.

validation.notes: Wire envelope shape, FromHTTP round trip, untyped bodies still yield stable codes, exit-code mapping. Tagged [REQ:STC-P0-017].
Connect errors carry the same errors.v1.Error detail with code, next action and details.
REST and Connect clients observe the same stable code for the same failure; migrated GET path writes the typed envelope.
TypeScript parseApiError decodes the typed envelope through ErrorSchema and falls back to status-derived codes.
